list.name: Incident events
list.rawSql: SELECT ie.occurred_at AS time, ie.title AS text, ARRAY[ie.entity_id, ie.event_type] AS tags FROM incident_events ie JOIN incidents i ON i.id = ie.incident_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ie.occurred_at)

description: Evidence-first incident detection and dependency-aware root-cause analysis for OpenTelemetry systems.

links.title: OpenTelemetry Demo
links.tooltip: Open the instrumented system under test

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::double precision AS value FROM incidents WHERE status IN ('open', 'monitoring')

panels.description: Highest calibrated probability for the selected incident.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT COALESCE(round(100 * probability)::double precision, 0) AS value FROM candidate_rankings WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 1

panels.title: Top-cause confidence

panels.description: Number of distinct components implicated by the selected incident.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT COALESCE(cardinality(affected_entities), 0)::double precision AS value FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)

panels.title: Affected components

panels.description: Seconds since the least-recent primary telemetry signal arrived.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - latest_at))), 0)::double precision AS value FROM v_telemetry_ingest_health WHERE signal IN ('spans', 'metrics', 'logs')

panels.title: Signal freshness

panels.description: Records rejected during normalization in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::double precision AS value FROM rejected_records WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Rejected records

panels.description: Currently promoted ranking model. A deterministic heuristic is shown when no learned champion exists.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT model_version FROM candidate_rankings WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 1), (SELECT name || ' · ' || version FROM model_versions WHERE status = 'champion' ORDER BY trained_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'heuristic · baseline') AS value

panels.title: Active model

panels.description: Select an incident above or use this table to scan recent investigations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id::text AS id, detected_at AS detected, status, severity, summary, COALESCE(top_entity_id, 'awaiting analysis') AS top_candidate, top_probability AS probability, COALESCE(top_fault_class, 'unknown') AS fault_class FROM v_incident_overview WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent incidents

panels.description: Ranked causal entities. Confidence is calibrated; low-confidence results should be treated as investigative leads.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT rank, entity_type AS type, entity_id AS candidate, fault_class, probability, confidence, round(score::numeric, 3) AS score, evidence_summary AS explanation FROM candidate_rankings WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 15

panels.title: Root-cause candidates

panels.description: Directed dependencies observed around the selected incident. Edge color reflects error rate and the secondary statistic shows p95 latency.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), target AS (SELECT started_at - interval '5 minutes' AS from_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '2 minutes' AS to_at, run_id FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), latest_edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_service, target_service) source_service, target_service, request_count, error_rate, latency_ms_p95, protocol FROM dependency_edges, target WHERE bucket_start BETWEEN target.from_at AND target.to_at AND (target.run_id IS NULL OR dependency_edges.run_id = target.run_id) ORDER BY source_service, target_service, bucket_start DESC) SELECT source_service || '→' || target_service AS id, source_service AS source, target_service AS target, request_count::double precision AS "mainStat", (round(100 * error_rate)::text || '% errors · ' || COALESCE(round(latency_ms_p95)::text, 'n/a') || ' ms p95') AS "secondaryStat", CASE WHEN error_rate >= 0.20 THEN 'red' WHEN error_rate >= 0.05 THEN 'orange' ELSE 'green' END AS color, protocol AS detail__protocol FROM latest_edges

panels.title: Observed failure-propagation graph

panels.description: Ordered evidence used to support or challenge each candidate.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT occurred_at AS time, evidence_type AS type, entity_id AS entity, signal_name AS signal, value, baseline, contribution, summary FROM evidence_items WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY occurred_at NULLS LAST, contribution DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

panels.title: Evidence ledger

panels.description: Anomaly magnitude by entity. Early rising series are important temporal evidence, not automatic proof of causality.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), target AS (SELECT started_at - interval '10 minutes' AS from_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '5 minutes' AS to_at, run_id FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)) SELECT bucket_start AS time, entity_id AS metric, anomaly_score AS value FROM feature_buckets, target WHERE bucket_start BETWEEN target.from_at AND target.to_at AND (target.run_id IS NULL OR feature_buckets.run_id = target.run_id) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Anomaly onset by component

panels.description: Error rate and p95 latency around the incident; use the dashboard time picker to zoom further.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), target AS (SELECT started_at - interval '10 minutes' AS from_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '5 minutes' AS to_at, run_id FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)) SELECT bucket_start AS time, entity_id AS metric, error_rate AS value FROM feature_buckets, target WHERE bucket_start BETWEEN target.from_at AND target.to_at AND (target.run_id IS NULL OR feature_buckets.run_id = target.run_id) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Error propagation

panels.description: Reviewed diagnostics and remediation steps matched to the ranked failure mechanism. The system never executes these automatically.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT cr.rank, cr.entity_id AS candidate, rb.title AS runbook, rb.description, rb.diagnostic_steps::text AS diagnose, rb.remediation_steps::text AS remediate, rb.verification_steps::text AS verify, r.rationale FROM recommendations r JOIN runbooks rb ON rb.id = r.runbook_id LEFT JOIN candidate_rankings cr ON cr.id = r.candidate_id WHERE r.incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY cr.rank NULLS LAST, r.compatibility_score DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Recommended investigation runbooks

panels.description: Human feedback closes the learning loop without changing the current incident result.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT created_at AS submitted, COALESCE(verdict, CASE WHEN accepted THEN 'correct' ELSE 'unknown' END) AS verdict, user_name AS reviewer, comment FROM developer_feedback WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: Developer feedback

panels.description: Collector-to-database flow by signal. A flat line may indicate an instrumentation, collector, or ingestion outage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', observed_at) AS time, 'spans' AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM spans WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', observed_at) AS time, 'metrics' AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM metric_points WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, 'logs' AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM log_records WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Telemetry throughput

panels.description: Latest timestamp and lifetime count for each stored signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal, records, latest_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - latest_at))::bigint AS age_seconds FROM v_telemetry_ingest_health ORDER BY signal

panels.title: Signal quality

panels.description: Champion/challenger registry and held-out evaluation metadata.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, version, model_kind AS architecture, status, trained_at AS trained, metrics::text AS evaluation FROM model_versions ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'champion' THEN 0 WHEN 'challenger' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, trained_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Model registry

panels.description: Reproducible labeled runs collected from the pinned OpenTelemetry Demo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT er.started_at AS started, er.name AS run, er.source_version AS demo_version, left(er.source_sha, 12) AS commit, er.seed, er.workload, er.status, COALESCE(er.split, 'unassigned') AS dataset_split, count(fi.id) AS injected_faults FROM experiment_runs er LEFT JOIN fault_injections fi ON fi.run_id = er.id WHERE er.created_at >= $__timeFrom() GROUP BY er.id ORDER BY er.started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

panels.title: Dataset & experiment lineage
